description: This file defines the NatsAdapterFactory class which implements IQueueAdapterFactory for the Orleans streaming framework, providing functionality to initialize and create NATS-based queue adapters, manage cache, queue mapping, and handle delivery failures.

classes.name: NatsAdapterFactory
classes.description: Implements IQueueAdapterFactory for creating and managing NATS stream adapters in Orleans, including configuration, initialization, and failure handling.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the factory, setting a default stream failure handler if none is set.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new NatsAdapter instance asynchronously.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache used for queue adapters.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns the stream queue mapper used for mapping streams to queues.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Returns a task that resolves to a stream failure handler for a specific queue ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of NatsAdapterFactory using dependency injection services and configuration.
